intro: Moldova is a small, landlocked country of rolling hills, rich black soil and vineyards.

chapters.title: Hills and rivers
text: Moldova lies between the Prut River, the border with Romania, and the Dniester. Its fertile black soil is ideal for farming. It touches the Danube for just a few hundred metres, enough for a small river port with access to the sea.

chapters.title: Cave monastery
text: At Orheiul Vechi, monks carved a monastery into a limestone cliff above a winding river.
